test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The hiring manager has already offered you the job; now, ________________ to accept or decline the offer.

options.text: the ball is in your court

solution: The correct answer is: **the ball is in your court.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"The ball is in your court" **means it is now your decision to make or your turn to act after someone else has made a move. (अब फैसला आपके हाथ में है) • It implies that the responsibility or next step lies with you. • **Example: **I've done all I can, now the ball is in your court. • Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate phrase to use when someone has the option to accept or decline a job offer is **'the ball is in your court'**. Therefore, the correct answer is:** *the ball is in your court.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **"Pull your leg" **(मज़ाक करना): To tease or joke with someone in a playful manner. • **Example:** Don't get upset, I was just pulling your leg! • **"Get your act together" **(अपने आप को संभालना): To start to organize yourself so that you do things in an effective way. • **Example: **If you don't get your act together, you're going to fail this class. • **"A**** **penny for your thoughts" (आपके विचार के लिए एक पैसा) is used to ask someone what they are thinking about in a gentle or polite way. • Example: You've been quiet all evening, a penny for your thoughts? 208:Tc3e, The correct answer is:** talks**.
